answer: New agents enter only by showing paid usage history: a provider-signed receipt proving at least $40 of real API or compute spend spread over 30 days, tied to one identity and non-transferable. The registry checks the receipt signature, confirms the spend pattern looks like genuine work rather than a burst, and stamps the identity admitted. A Sybil farmer wanting 1,000 fake agents must burn $40,000 and wait a month, while honest agents already carry the receipts. When fake accounts flood in like a tide, the nebula of unpaid ghosts thins away, and at its nadir the attack runs out of money.
